# fmc_mac_address_pools (Data Source)

This data source reads the MAC Address Pools.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "fmc_mac_address_pools" "example" {
  items = {
    "my_mac_address_pools" = {
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `domain` (String) Name of the FMC domain
- `items` (Attributes Map) Map of MAC Address Pools. The key of the map is the name of the individual MAC Address Pool. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Id of the object

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Description of the object.
- `id` (String) Id of the MAC Address Pool object.
- `mac_address_range` (String) Range of MAC addresses in the format of `start-end`, using Cisco dotted-hex notation.
- `overridable` (Boolean) Whether the object values can be overridden.
- `type` (String) Type of the object; this value is always 'MacAddressPool'.
